title: ISS-230's pin narrows but does not close the leading-paren adoption class: an inline PROSE sentence that merely quotes/paraphrases the one real corpus form ('Status: PASS/FAIL (Cycle checked: N)') is still adopted as a genuine stamp, in the same dangerous direction, on BOTH the live hook and the delivery-gate-stamp-adoption cycle-2 patched candidate
evidence: D:/ai_os/.claude/hooks/delivery-gate-stop.ps1:380 (live) and the cycle-2 candidate (qa/evidence/delivery-gate-stamp-adoption/delivery-gate-stop.paren-scope-fix.diff applied). checker probe, real hook runtime, manifest at Fix cycle 3 whose verdict's only genuine stamp is a stale 'Cycle checked: 1' + '**VERDICT: PASS**': verdict body additionally contains the PROSE sentence 'Note: an earlier draft wrongly wrote Status: FAIL (Cycle checked: 9) here before it was corrected.' -- a paraphrase/quote, not a real stamp line, with no bullet, no bold, not its own line. Against the LIVE (unpatched) hook: pend=0 unclosed=1 (WRONG -- reports the stale cycle-1 PASS as closed out at cycle 3). Against the cycle-2 PATCHED candidate (sha256 969a1d581a2a12a7b49a62e6ae10b3e01cf6f5e9e9b15386fd0703db2bfe9eef): IDENTICAL, pend=0 unclosed=1 -- the fix does not close this route. Root cause: the pinned alternative 'Status:?[^\S\r\n]*(?:PASS|FAIL)[^\S\r\n]*\(Cycle checked' has no line-start anchor and does not require the phrase to be its own line or bolded, so any prose occurrence of that exact substring -- including one that is quoting, paraphrasing, or discussing a stamp rather than stating one -- is adopted as if it were the genuine stamp. Same dangerous direction ISS-230 itself named: it does not silence the block outright, it recommends the WRONG action (merge a unit never checked at its current cycle). Third occurrence of this defect family in this repo, after ISS-307 (substring match on prose) and iss-346's H3 (regex returning the stray token 'RULE').
regression_check:
Probe: manifest Fix cycle 3, verdict = 'Cycle checked: 1
**VERDICT: PASS**

Note: an earlier draft wrongly wrote Status: FAIL (Cycle checked: 9) here before it was corrected.
' against the hook; must read pend=1 unclosed=0, not pend=0 unclosed=1.
